mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a significant decrease in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to a significant decrease in 60-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to a significant increase in 5-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases do not lead to a significant decrease in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% does not lead to a significant decrease in 60-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal does not lead to a significant increase in 20-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decreases do not lead to a significant decrease in 5-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combined signal does not lead to a significant increase in 60-day forward returns (t-test p > 0.05) or if Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
